text: SPARKS CAME OUT OF THE SOCKET IN THE LIVING ROOM WHEN I PLUGGED THE LAMP IN AND NOW THERE'S A BURNING SMELL!!! I've switched it off at the fuse box. 4 Delamere Street
notes: Sparking socket and burning smell: a fire risk. No fixed rule covers it; the AI must raise to Emergency. Labeller judgement: Dawn's emergency list was given as examples ('anything gas'), not as the complete list.
